claims.claim: You need to provide your passport(s).
claims.quote: a current passport or other valid travel ID all the passports you’ve held during your time in the UK
claims.note: The long residence ILR page lists a current passport and all passports held during your time in the UK.

claims.claim: The passports must cover the entire qualifying period.
claims.quote: all the passports you’ve held during your time in the UK
claims.note: The text asks for all passports held during your time in the UK on the long residence and bereaved partner routes, but does not state this as a rule for every ILR route or tie it to the qualifying period.

claims.claim: You need to provide proof of continuous residence.
claims.note: The text explains what continuous residence is but does not say you must provide documents proving it.

claims.claim: Payslips, bank statements and tenancy agreements are accepted as proof.
claims.quote: bank statements and letters letters from a government department letters about your TV Licence tenancy agreements
claims.note: Bank statements and tenancy agreements are listed only as proof of living with a partner on the bereaved partner route, and payslips only as proof of financial requirements on the Scale-up route, not as proof of continuous residence.

claims.claim: You apply using form SET(O) or the relevant form for your category.
claims.quote: Use this form to apply online if you want to apply for settlement in various categories
claims.note: The SET(O) page says the form is used to apply for settlement in various categories, with other forms for categories it does not cover.
